faq_heading: Fraser Heights houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Fraser Heights. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Fraser Heights, Surrey: 88 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 9 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 6 of 15 Surrey communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Fraser Heights rose from 86 in June to 88 in September (+2.3%), and 36 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 7.9% of Surrey’s 1,120 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Fraser Heights?
Fraser Heights also had 19 condos and townhomes listed and 0 sold in September, against 88 houses listed. The Fraser Heights condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Fraser Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

82 houses sold in Fraser Heights with a median price of $1,559,000 (the middle half sold between $1,380,000 and $1,727,500), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 95.7% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $509 per square foot, a median year built of 1996 and a median lot of 7,190 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Fraser Heights?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 88 houses listed in Fraser Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Fraser Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Fraser Heights had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Fraser Heights from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 36 houses sold in Fraser Heights over those 4 months, out of 351 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Fraser Heights?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Fraser Heights sell for?
faq.a: 82 houses sold in Fraser Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,559,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Fraser Heights?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.7% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
